T1.name: Definition of Linked System
T1.raw_latex:
\begin{defn}
Two quartet trees are \emph{linked} if their vertices are connected in $G_T(Q)$. The system of quartet trees $Q$, is \emph{a linked system} if $G_T(Q)$ is connected.
